purpose: Cross-compile the peripheral-free 60 Hz FreeRTOS game/runtime task split with a fake cartridge, neutral input, and no-op render sink.
runtime_blockers: The app is build-only and has not been flashed or hardware-tested.
The fake render sink does not initialize or submit to the Elecrow display.
The cartridge receiver is transport-independent and has no USB CDC/Web Serial adapter or durable storage backend.
The executable cartridge engine and browser implementation of the shared API are follow-on milestones.
